AcpExec: Unified ACP agent invocation. Supports prompt (single message), think (sequential thinking), and workflow (structured workflow) modes. All modes share a global agent pool for process reuse.
Adopt: Loads a role, color, or perspective asset as an adoption instruction.
AnalyzeConceptCorruption: Analyzes concept families to find duplicate or corrupted WikiLink variants.
AssumptionLedger: Creates, updates, or reads assumptions linked to workflow or thinking context.
BuildContext: Builds graph context around a concept by traversing related knowledge.
DeleteMemory: Deletes an existing knowledge file after explicit confirmation.
DeleteWorkflowAsset: Deletes one workflow asset by name when no running pipeline references it.
EditMemory: Modifies an existing knowledge file while preserving WikiLinks.
EmbeddingModels: Manages embedding models and ONNX Runtime downloads. List curated models, check status, and download runtime assets.
ExtractConceptsFromFile: Extracts WikiLink concepts from a specific knowledge file.
FindSimilarConcepts: Finds semantically similar concepts using vector embeddings.
GetConfig: Displays maenifold configuration settings and resolved paths.
GetCopilotModels: Fetches Copilot /models capabilities through the daemon cache and returns exact per-model reasoning-effort options.
GetHelp: Loads canonical help for a named public MCP tool or gateway command. Use it after you know which tool or command needs deeper usage details. It complements GatewayIndex; it is not the first cold-start domain discovery call.
ListAssets: Lists available asset types or metadata for a specific asset type.
ListMemories: Lists knowledge files or folders relative to the memory root.
ListSessions: Lists resumable ACP sessions across configured agents.
MemoryStatus: Provides high-level memory system statistics and health information.
MoveMemory: Moves or renames a knowledge file while preserving WikiLinks.
Pipeline: Creates and manages pipeline sessions composed of DAG nodes.
ReadMcpResource: Reads a concrete MCP resource URI such as asset://catalog or asset://.../id. Use it when you already have a resource URI and need packaged resource content. It does not discover gateway domains or read memory:// notes; use GatewayIndex for domains.
ReadMemory: Retrieves an existing knowledge file by URI or title.
ReadTextFile: Reads a UTF-8 text file from an absolute path or a cwd-relative path.
RecentActivity: Reports recently indexed files with optional content excerpts.
RepairConcepts: Repairs concept variants across memory files by replacing them with a canonical form.
RunFullBenchmark: Runs system performance benchmarks across search, sync, and graph traversal.
SaveWorkflowAsset: Saves (creates or overwrites) a workflow asset by id.
SearchMemories: Searches knowledge files using hybrid, semantic, or full-text ranking.
SequentialThinking: Creates structured thinking sessions with persistent branching, conclusions, and child submachines.
Sync: Synchronizes WikiLink concepts from memory files into the graph database.
UpdateAssets: Refreshes runtime assets from packaged assets with optional dry-run mode.
Visualize: Generates Mermaid or graph JSON output for concept relationships.
Workflow: Runs structured workflows with optional nested submachines.
WriteMemory: Creates new knowledge files with [[WikiLinks]] for graph integration.
